systems.tiers: Dedicated enrolment centres from 3 April 2024 in Grand Libreville (Libreville, Owendo, Akanda, Ntoum), then nationwide in a second phase; in Akanda two of the three sites are arrondissement mairies (Cap Estérias and Angondjé), the rest police stations, DGDI offices, a prefecture and public spaces

note: Interior Ministry notice on NIP enrolment: two arrondissement mairies in Akanda host the ministry's enrolment centres, but the document does not say the mairie is connected or that its staff work in the system.
